title: Persistent model revisions and Construction Graph bridge
objective: Turn the real-geometry CAD workflow into a persistent, versioned product workflow while preserving the Construction Graph as the canonical system of record (LOCK-019, §5.4, §9, data-model.md §2/§3/§5, event-model.md §1/§2/§4). The CADDocument gains an immutable, append-only model revision history that persists across save/open through the unchanged FileEngineAdapter boundary; every document transition (edit/undo/redo) records a revision with its version metadata (data-model.md §2), content hash, applied edit and element-set delta. CAD element identity becomes a first-class document authority: ids are stable across revisions and sessions (duplicate ids rejected; the document mints canonical ids when callers omit them), while engine ids remain provenance only (LOCK-019). An explicit Construction Graph bridge (app/src/graph/) maps the revision history into a deterministic graph-facing domain event stream — one model.created for the base plus one model.version.created per revision, each carrying the revision reference, affected elements, per-element provenance and an explicit uncertainty state (§2.7, LOCK-007) — consuming only domain contracts, never engine internals. Historical replay is deterministic and information-state correct (only the base plus the first k revisions are consumed; no future leakage), exposed through the additive App API queries model.getHistory / model.getGraphEvents / model.replay (api-contract.md §8). Web and Electron produce semantically identical revision/event results through the shared App API (LOCK-017); the dummy adapter remains the permanent test double and the frozen adapter contracts are untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Save/reopen preserves geometry, identity, provenance and version lineage: document.save bytes through the unchanged FileEngineAdapter boundary carry the immutable model history; document.open adopts it (structurally validated + linkage-checked) and continues appending revisions whose parent linkage points at the reopened head; legacy artifacts without a history open with a seeded 'opened' base (LOCK-005/LOCK-012).

Model revisions are immutable and replayable: revisions are append-only frozen records (monotonic numbering, deterministic ids `<entity>#r<n>(<hash12>)`, fixed timestamps); replaying the history to any revision k consumes only the base plus the first k revisions and reproduces the recorded element set and content hash (information-state correct, no future leakage, LOCK-005/LOCK-006).

CAD element identity remains stable across revisions; engine IDs remain provenance only: element ids survive edits/undo/redo/save/open/replay verbatim; duplicate addElement ids are rejected; the document mints canonical ids (el-NNNNNN, monotonic, never reused) when callers omit one; graph node ids derive from (document entity id, element id) only — the same element id with different or absent engine provenance maps to the SAME graph node (LOCK-019).

The Graph bridge consumes explicit domain contracts and imports no engine internals: app/src/graph/ imports only contracts/, caddocument/ and node:crypto (statically asserted by test); the forbidden-import static check (LOCK-018) is extended to cover src/graph.

A revision produces a deterministic graph-facing event containing revision, affected elements, provenance and uncertainty state: one model.created for the base + one model.version.created per revision (event-model.md §2), each carrying the full event envelope (event_id, event_type, event_version, occurred_at, actor, source entity/version/revision, causation chain, correlation id) and a payload with the revision reference, element-set delta, per-element projections (graph node id, engine id as provenance, epistemic labels per §2.7/LOCK-007) and revision provenance; the same history yields byte-identical events on every run.

Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic revision/event results: the same command/query sequence through WebHost+WebSocketTransport and ElectronHost+IpcTransport yields identical revision histories (canonical JSON), identical graph event streams (events_hash) and identical replay results — with the dummy adapter and, engine-gated, with the real OCCT adapter so revisions carry genuine engine provenance (LOCK-017, §5.5).

Existing shell + real-engine tests remain green; new persistence/Graph tests are added: the 74-test CAD-001/002 suite is untouched and green; new model-history / model-persistence / model-replay / graph-bridge / model-host-parity tests (35 new) cover every acceptance criterion; engine-absent environments skip the engine-gated tests with recorded reasons (0 failures).

CI reproduces persistence and Graph-bridge tests: the cad-implement-003 workflow runs the full suite (engine-free + real-engine), the forbidden-import check with src/graph, the web host build + live revision/bridge smoke and the Electron host smokes including the new smoke:model (revisions + Graph bridge + save/open persistence through a real BrowserWindow).

No protected architecture paths are modified: spec/** protected artifacts untouched; app/src/contracts/adapter.ts byte-unchanged; App API changes are additive queries only (api-contract.md §8); Architecture v1.1 remains FROZEN.
non_goals: Quantity/estimate propagation (QTY-*): out of scope per Issue #28 — follows once the revision/Graph foundation is proven.
IFC authoring/round-trip and full BIM authoring: out of scope per Issue #28.

Graph-side consumption infrastructure (event bus/store subscriptions): the bridge produces the deterministic event stream through the App API; platform-side durable event infrastructure is a separate work item (PLATFORM-005 track).
Architecture modification: Architecture v1.1 remains FROZEN; no protected path touched; no ACR — the frozen contracts were sufficient (additive extension only).
Final packaging: out of scope per Issue #28.
risk_assumptions: CODE-LEVEL INHERITANCE (governance dependency note): CAD-IMPLEMENT-001 and CAD-IMPLEMENT-002 are merged to main (e19327e) but their governance records remain PR_OPEN (not VERIFIED), so they CANNOT be declared as formal dependencies under the VERIFIED-dependency rule (no override mechanism exists). This work item branches from main@e19327e (the Architect directive's explicit target) and declares only the VERIFIED items whose findings it consumes directly: ARCH-WF-001 (governance foundation) and RESEARCH-CAD-003 (the canonical-identity / CAD→Construction-Graph mapping research — engine GlobalIds unstable across regeneration, canonical domain ids stable, per-node provenance blocks). Recorded for Architect visibility, not hidden.

SPEC DIVERGENCE (same pattern as CAD-IMPLEMENT-001/002): spec/work-items.md defines PLATFORM-004 ('Versioning, lineage and audit'), PLATFORM-005 ('Event bus and domain event contracts') and GRAPH-001 ('Canonical domain model') as the closest frozen ancestors. CAD-IMPLEMENT-003 is defined by Issue #28 as a new production-implementation work item scoped to the CAD/BIM revision/Graph foundation specifically; the implementer follows Issue #28 and flags the divergence.

EVENT VOCABULARY DECISION: event-model.md §2 lists model.created / model.version.created / model.element.changed / model.version.approved. Issue #28 requires 'a revision produces a deterministic graph-facing event containing revision, affected elements, provenance, and uncertainty state' (singular per revision) — this slice emits model.created (once, at the base boundary) + model.version.created (one per revision, elements embedded in the payload). model.element.changed (per-element events) and model.version.approved remain future vocabulary; the additive payload structure supports them without contract changes.

PARITY HASH SEMANTICS: currentContentHash (the LOCK-017/§5.5 parity hash) EXCLUDES the model history — the existing undo/redo convergence acceptance criterion (different paths to the same content must converge to the same hash) requires content-only hashing. History/event parity is proven separately via historyHash + events_hash equality across hosts (a stronger, orthogonal assertion). The version-id derivation hash remains content-only (unchanged since CAD-001).

MINTED IDENTITY FORMAT: document-minted canonical ids use el-NNNNNN (zero-padded 6 digits, monotonic from history.next_element_sequence). The counter is persisted with the history and never regresses — a minted identity is never reused across revisions, sessions or undo. Caller-supplied ids (the UI's UUIDs, tests' literals) remain canonical verbatim; only missing/empty/non-string ids are minted.

ENVIRONMENT LIMITATIONS (recorded per acceptance criteria): the real-engine parity/evidence tests require python3 + cadquery-ocp 7.8.1.1.post1 and skip with recorded reasons when absent (the CAD-002 gating pattern); the engine-free revision/bridge/persistence/replay tests (the large majority) run everywhere; the Electron smoke:model is engine-free by design (engine ids in provenance are data).

evidence.description: Deterministic revision/Graph test suite (the core acceptance evidence). The app/ suite grows 74 -> 109 tests: the 74 CAD-IMPLEMENT-001/002 tests remain UNTOUCHED and green, plus 35 new tests in five files. (1) app/test/model-history.test.ts (9) — immutable revision recording: every execute/undo/redo appends exactly one frozen revision (notes edit/undo/redo, monotonic numbering, deterministic ids <entity>#r<n>(<hash12>), fixed timestamps, append-only integrity proven by prefix-preservation); element-set deltas (added/removed/updated, lexicographically sorted); from_version_id linkage across undo/redo transitions; duplicate addElement id rejected (identity never reused) with no revision appended; document-minted identities el-000001/el-000002 (monotonic, never reused across remove+undo); two identically-driven documents produce byte-identical histories; the snapshot carries the history and open adopts it. (2) app/test/model-persistence.test.ts (6) — save -> open preserves geometry, identity, provenance, version lineage, history (byte-identical canonical JSON) and the graph events_hash; revisions continue appending after reopen with parent linkage to the reopened head; serialize -> deserialize round-trip preserves the history; legacy snapshots without history open with a seeded 'opened' base (replay of revision 0 reproduces the opened elements); corrupt histories rejected, never guessed or repaired (tampered content hash fails replay integrity verification with typed replay_failed; broken numbering/linkage fails structural validation with typed open_failed/deserialize_failed); duplicate id through the App API is typed edit_failed. (4) app/test/graph-bridge.test.ts (10) — one model.created for the base + one model.version.created per revision; every event carries the full event-model.md §4 envelope (event_id/event_type/event_version/occurred_at/actor/source entity+version+revision/correlation_id + payload revision/affected/elements/provenance/uncertainty); causation chain links every event to its predecessor with model.created as the root and unique event ids; revision events carry the recorded revision reference + delta; engine ids are provenance ONLY (graph node ids derive from document entity + element id — the same element id with different/absent engine id maps to the SAME node; engine id absent from the node id); node ids stable across revisions and document-scoped; per-element uncertainty (identity OBSERVED, geometry_provenance OBSERVED/UNKNOWN, semantics UNKNOWN) and revision-level OBSERVED/UNKNOWN/MIXED labels (§2.7, LOCK-007); the bridge is deterministic (byte-identical events + hash on repeat) and frozen; the bridge imports ONLY contracts/, caddocument/ and node:crypto (statically asserted). The LOCK-018 forbidden-import static check is extended to scan src/graph (no-forbidden-imports.test.ts, PROTECTED_DIRS + src/graph). evidence.description: The revision/Graph foundation implementation (inspectable source, commit 308fb3a). DOMAIN CONTRACTS: app/src/contracts/model.ts (NEW, engine-free, additive — the geometry.ts precedent) — ModelRevision (revision_number/revision_id/from_version_id/version(VersionMeta)/content_hash/applied_edit/delta/note/created_at/created_by), RevisionDelta (sorted canonical ids), RevisionBase (origin created|opened + the pre-log information state), ModelHistory (entity_id/format/formatVersion/base/next_element_sequence/revisions), the graph-facing event contracts (GraphModelEventType model.created|model.version.created, GRAPH_MODEL_EVENT_VERSION '1', RevisionRef, EpistemicLabel OBSERVED|CALCULATED|INFERRED|EXTRAPOLATED|GUESSED|UNKNOWN per §2.7, ElementUncertainty, RevisionUncertainty OBSERVED|UNKNOWN|MIXED, GraphElementProjection with graph_node_id + engineId-as-provenance, RevisionProvenance, GraphModelEventPayload, GraphModelEvent with the full event-model.md §4 envelope, GraphBridgeResult with events_hash, ModelReplayResult with verified). HISTORY ENGINE: app/src/caddocument/history.ts (NEW) — appendRevision (append-only, deep-frozen), diffElements (sorted canonical deltas), createdHistory/openedHistory (legacy artifacts seed the base), deriveElementSequence (el-NNNNNN counter), replayHistoryTo (deterministic fold over the base + first k revisions — information-state correct, no future leakage), applyEditToElements (strict, no guessed state), validateModelHistory + validateHistoryLinkage (LOCK-007 structural validation), baseContentHash/historyHash/verifiedReplay (LOCK-005 integrity). CADDocument integration (document.ts) — every execute/undo/redo appends an immutable revision (note edit/undo/redo, from_version_id linkage); the snapshot carries modelHistory (additive optional field on CADDocumentSnapshot; legacy artifacts still open); open adopts + validates the persisted history or seeds an 'opened' base; canonical identity authority (normalizeEdit: duplicate ids rejected, missing/empty/non-string ids minted el-NNNNNN, counter persisted + never regressing); currentContentHash EXCLUDES the history (the §5.4/§5.5 content-only parity invariant — undo/redo convergence preserved, proven by the untouched 74-test suite); deserialize validates the persisted history. GRAPH BRIDGE: app/src/graph/bridge.ts + index.ts (NEW) — graphNodeId = 'cg:cad-element:' + SHA-256(canonical{entity_id, element_id}) (engine ids NEVER participate — LOCK-019); bridgeModelHistory emits one model.created (base: revision ref with content hash, all base elements as added projections, provenance origin created|opened, revision-level uncertainty) + one model.version.created per revision (revision ref, recorded delta, per-element projections sorted by element id, provenance with note + actor + source_snapshot_id + lineage, affected-element uncertainty summary) causation-chained in order with unique deterministic event ids ('cge1:' + SHA-256 over type+version+entity+revision); everything deep-frozen; events_hash = SHA-256 over the canonical event encoding. APP API (additive only, api-contract.md §8) — QueryName + model.getHistory/model.getGraphEvents/model.replay; AJV schemas (model.replay requires a non-negative integer revision_number); dispatch with typed errors (graph_bridge_failed, replay_failed on integrity violation, bad_payload on malformed/out-of-range input, open_failed on corrupt history); document.open now validates + adopts the persisted history. The frozen app/src/contracts/adapter.ts is byte-unchanged; no protected path touched.
